hook: Workers tested a wearable trunk posture feedback system for six weeks.

sections.voiceover: Workers tested a wearable trunk posture feedback system for six weeks.
b_roll: Close up shot of a wearable posture sensor device in a distribution center.

sections.voiceover: Researchers like Maury A. Nussbaum evaluated the technology. Investigator Jiwon Choi tracked the workers during the test. Applied Ergonomics published the field study in its pages. How effective and usable was this trunk posture feedback system over six weeks?
b_roll: Academic journal page showing the title and authors.
